preconditions.description: The number of queries N is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= 10**9 and 1 <= j <= 10**9 for i, j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two integers i and j, both between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output is equal to the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(distance, int) and distance >= 0 for distance in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains a non-negative integer representing the shortest path length.

postconditions.expression: all(distance == shortest_path_length(i, j) for (i, j), distance in zip(queries, output))
postconditions.description: Each output distance corresponds to the shortest path length between nodes i and j for each query.
